method: Read from benchmark page DOM. Values rounded to 0.001 ms. First invocation per case is not a fresh browser/engine. 2 warmups then 7 alternating-order repeats. No forced GC. Same inputs and source hashes as comparison-node.json. Heap/peak not measured.
limitations: Desktop only; no CPU throttling or phone. Timer baseline around 4-6 ms for tiny inputs; zero means below timer resolution, not zero cost. Long-task observer covers whole benchmark; count/durations align with reference dense invocations, without per-task attribution instrumentation. Full UI preparation/render latency and memory peak unmeasured.
